purpose: One shared CPU execution entry for prepared candidates; not an additional segmentation method
resource_state: User shut down the instance. This preparation starts no server, GPU or actual cohort experiment.
infer_example: python scripts/run_cpu_feature_candidates.py infer --backend prepared --prepared-methods adjacency huber color_bottleneck constellation reference_shape reference_covariance query_recurrence --primary-method adjacency --manifest rows.json --root /workspace --out run_prepared_v1 --workers 6 --threads 4 --cpu-budget 30 --memory-gb 60
example_status: Example paths must be bound to the actual cohort. These commands were not launched on actual data.

manifest.format: JSON episodes list or object containing episodes
manifest.feature_export: NPZ q/r or existing CPU-loadable Torch q/r cache, aligned4096x1024; query GT is not consumed
manifest.packet_export: Existing inference cov/score and separately scored truth/native arrays. Inference opens only cov/score; score opens truth/native after sealing.
manifest.color_binding: For the color method provide query_rgb_export with an RGB128 NPZ rgb array, or query_image_export pointing to the actual query image. No image root is guessed.
manifest.shape_geometry: For reference_shape provide support_image_hw and query_image_hw as original positive integer [height,width] arrays; never use the canonical64 square as guessed original geometry.
manifest.covariance_method: reference_covariance uses reference foreground component-level mode-response covariance; no original image geometry is required.
manifest.recurrence_method: query_recurrence forms a query appearance prototype from a supported star of high-confidence query components; it uses no additional image or query labels.
manifest.existing_mean: Optional base_field_export/base_field_key is accepted only after numerical consistency with the bound MEAN graph. Current threshold maxabs<=1e-6; this is not a bitwise parity assertion for actual data.
manifest.photo_identity: Provide support_photo_id/query_photo_id for canonical identities where shard filenames repeat; preserve all natural sample occurrences.
manifest.additional_complete_baselines: evaluation_controls can bind existing complete INSID3/FoRIS/other packed1024 output files; they are opened only during score, not used by candidate inference.

shared_work: Read each occurrence's feature and packet caches once; do not materialize query truth.
Reconstruct fixed MEAN pre-graph target/fidelity/query graph once. Preserve normalized graph storage dtype and original CG arithmetic for the common baseline.
Run each unchanged candidate against the bound base and save its declared complete mask/readout and strong simple controls.
Record shared preprocessing time separately from each candidate-plus-controls time and complete occurrence time; shared execution does not demonstrate any complete-dataset minute budget.
Keep all occurrences even when their source cache/key is reused.
Seal metadata, receipts, fields and predictions before the separate scoring command. No automatic best-method selection or parameter fitting.
Report all requested predeclared candidate rows, class-summed I/U mIoU, 2000 RandomState(0) connected-photo group draws, paired intervals and four types of additions/deletions.
guards: Owned CPU worker/thread budget at most30
Declared memory budget at most60GB and actual cgroup bound
Missing RGB binding fails before output creation
Changed sealed metadata/predictions/fields/packets rejected before scoring
Query class/fold/photo identifiers removed from the worker input descriptor
verification: bundle_check.json: shared synthetic infer/score checks through seven candidates, including the four-method regression; covariance_preparation_01a1100b/runner_check.json and recurrence_preparation_01a1100b/runner_check.json: per-candidate two-worker inference and sealed masks. All method-specific checks are analytical/synthetic only. Real episodes=0.
quality_status: All seven remain empirically unvalidated hypotheses. Common execution and synthetic verification are preparation, not proof of high-quality segmentation or originality.
